context.assumption_method: Group Shapiro (seeded maximum 5000) and median-centred Levene at alpha; non-rejection does not establish assumptions; KW for failures, no median-only claim without common shapes
context.sparse_method: Fixed-margin conditional Monte Carlo Pearson statistic, 19999 resamples, seed 42; finite MC resolution and standard error reported
context.cv_scoring: .4 macro F1 + .6 mean High/Critical recall; no accuracy objective
context.ranking_formula: .30 High recall + .30 Critical recall - .15 under - .30 severe under - .10 over + .20 macro F1 - .10 Brier - .10 patient-bootstrap HC recall SD
context.bootstrap_description: 200 patient-cluster resamples conditional on fixed validation predictions, common seed
